case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states the accused's temple roles, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status is not stated; only cash and investments are noted.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Gadadharanandji is referred to as male throughout.

victim_religion.reason: Victim religion is not expressly stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Known: fellow temple functionaries/trustees; accused resented the victim's proposed transfer of the Kotharis
accused_victim_relationship.quote: the Chairman, Gadadharanandji, proposed to transfer the Kotharis away from the Vadtal Temple
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused were temple insiders with a motive tied to the victim's proposal, not strangers.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under s.302 with conspiracy and kidnapping.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302 r/w s.120-B, s.364 and s.201
statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 302 r/w 120-B, 364 and 20 l of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment body cites s.201, not s.301 as extracted; s.301 is a headnote misprint.

weapon.correct_value: Cloth ('khesiya') used for strangulation per panchnama; sedating tablets also used
weapon.quote: then strangled him there using the deceased's 'khcsiya' (cloth usually placed around the neck)
weapon.reason: Judgment describes strangulation with a cloth and drugging, so 'None mentioned' is incorrect.

evidence_type.reason: Prosecution case hinges on circumstantial evidence, per paragraph 40.

confession.correct_value: No formal confession admitted; Accused 3 is described as confessing in a panchnama; s.27 disclosures by Accused 3 and 5
confession.quote: wherein he is stated to have confessed that he himself kidnapped Gadadharanandji
confession.reason: 'None' ignores the panchnama confession narrative and the s.27 disclosure statements relied on.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Trial court called the case rarest of rare; prosecution did not support that before the High Court. Circumstances: strong motive, conspiracy, body disposal, false insurance claim
aggravating_circumstances.quote: a rarest of rare case warranting the death penalty
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Listed circumstances are supported, but the rarest-of-rare framing was not accepted and is omitted.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are stated in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted all five accused (1-5), including Accused 4, under s.302 r/w 120-B and sentenced to death
trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted all the five accused for offence under Section 302 r/w 120-B
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted Accused 4 too; the value omits him.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court acquitted Accused 4 and commuted the death sentence to life imprisonment.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeals, upholding convictions of Accused 1, 2 and 5.

offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 r/w 120-B was upheld.

imprisonment_type.reason: High Court commuted death to life imprisonment, upheld by the Supreme Court.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term of years is given for the life sentence.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Accused were temple functionaries (Assistant Kothari, assistant, henchmen), not all Board members; facts framed as prosecution case without stating the outcome

neutral_facts.reason: Wrongly says accused were Board members, and states 'the prosecution established' contested findings, revealing the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Trial court imposed death; High Court commuted to life for s.302 conviction.

attempt_completion.reason: Victim was killed, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Victim's death by strangulation is established.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Not stated (convictions under s.302, s.364 and s.201, each r/w s.120-B)

premeditation_planning.reason: Trial court held the crime involved pre-planning; conspiracy was upheld.

motive.reason: Fear of transfer, loss of control and financial irregularities is the accepted motive.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: The listed circumstances match those the Court accepted.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Matches the account of car burning, garage handover and rejected insurance claim.
